definitions.explanation: Motorboat racing on which bets are legally placed; one of Japan's publicly run gambling sports.

examples.japanese: {競艇|きょうてい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{負|ま}けた→負ける：01134_makeru⟧。
examples.english: I lost at the boat races.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{競艇|きょうてい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: My father goes to the boat races on weekends.

examples.japanese: {競艇|きょうてい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{競馬|けいば}→競馬：00207_keiba⟧や⟦{競輪|けいりん}→競輪：09247_keirin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧⟦{公営|こうえい}→公営：22485_kouei⟧⟦ギャンブル→ギャンブル：10811_gyanburu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Boat racing is one of Japan's public gambling sports, along with horse racing and keirin.

notes:
With ⟦{競馬|けいば}→競馬：00207_keiba⟧ (horse racing), ⟦{競輪|けいりん}→競輪：09247_keirin⟧ (bicycle racing) and オート⟦レース→レース：31262_reesu⟧ (motorcycle racing), it is one of the publicly run gambling sports ({公営競技|こうえいきょうぎ}), and part of the takings go to local governments. Six boats race three laps of a 600-meter course. The official brand name since 2010 is ⟦ボート→ボート：00018_booto⟧⟦レース→レース：31262_reesu⟧, but {競艇|きょうてい} remains the everyday word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {競艇場|きょうていじょう}: boat race stadium
- {競艇選手|きょうていせんしゅ}: boat racer
- {競艇|きょうてい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{当|あ}てる→当てる：01864_ateru⟧: to win a bet at the boat races

WATCH OUT:
⟦{協定|きょうてい}→協定：05320_kyoutei⟧ (agreement) has the same reading and is unrelated.
